implemented_requirements.requirement: Two-player vertical paddles controlled by separate keys (up/down)
implemented_requirements.evidence: paddle.py defines Paddle with up_key/down_key; Game.__init__ creates two Paddle instances using PLAYER1_UP_KEY/PLAYER1_DOWN_KEY and PLAYER2_UP_KEY/PLAYER2_DOWN_KEY from settings.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball moves across the screen and bounces off the top and bottom edges
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ball.update in ball.py updates rect position and reverses velocity_y when rect.top <= 0 or rect.bottom >= SCREEN_HEIGHT.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball bounces off paddles with angle based on hit position and speed increase
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ball.bounce_off_paddle in ball.py computes hit_position, adjusts angle, increments speed (capped by BALL_MAX_SPEED), and sets new velocity_x/velocity_y.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Players score a point when the opponent misses the ball
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.check_scoring detects ball.rect.right < 0 or ball.rect.left > SCREEN_WIDTH and calls handle_point, which increments the appropriate player's score via Scoreboard.score_point.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Winning score threshold and game‑over handling
implemented_requirements.evidence: Scoreboard.get_winner returns a player index when a score reaches WINNING_SCORE; Game.handle_point sets state to STATE_GAME_OVER if a winner exists, and Game.render draws the game‑over overlay.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball is reset to the centre after each point with a short serve delay
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.handle_point calls ball.reset(serve_direction) and sets serve_timer = SERVE_DELAY_FRAMES; Game.update skips ball movement while serve_timer > 0.

judge.summary: All core Pong features are present in the provided source files: two controllable paddles, ball physics with wall and paddle bounces, scoring, a configurable winning score, and automatic ball reset with a serve delay. The code is coherent and appears ready to run with pygame, giving a high likelihood of successful execution.
